exercises.q: В ___ (кишечный) тракте человека живут миллионы полезных микроорганизмов.
exercises.prompt: Millions of beneficial organisms live in the human digestive tract.
exercises.why: Notes. 1. Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension. 2. All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify. 3. The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом. 4. Ordinal numerals (except «третий») are declined like "hard" adjectives. Notice that the feminine adjectives have the same ending -ой (-ей) for all cases except for the nominative and accusative. In spite of -ш-, «большая» belongs to the guttural type: большой, большую. «твой, твоё,… — DLI, Lessons 46 and 47.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
